messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. Let me make a decent SVG — bicycle with two wheels, frame, handlebars, pedals, and a pelican body with a big beak/pouch, sitting on the seat, wings on the handlebars, legs pedaling.

Let me plan the layout: canvas 800x500. Wheels centered at (220, 380) and (560, 380), radius 80. Frame connecting. Pelican sits on top around x 350-450, body an ellipse, long neck, head with big beak and pouch facing right. Wings reaching forward to the handlebars. Legs down to the pedals.

Let me lay out the coordinates:

- Rear wheel: center (200, 380), r=75
- Front wheel: center (560, 380), r=75
- Crank/bottom bracket: (380, 380)
- Seat tube goes up from crank to seat (350, 240)
- Top tube goes to head tube top (490, 230)
- Down tube goes from bottom bracket to head tube bottom (505, 265)
- Chainstay goes from crank to rear hub
- Seatstay goes from seat to rear hub
- Fork goes from head tube to front hub
- Handlebars at (485, 205)

Pelican: body ellipse around center (360, 210), rx 70, ry 45, tilted. Neck extends up and forward from (410, 180) to head at (470, 120). Head circle r~22 placed at (475, 115). Beak: long, upper mandible extends from head toward lower right, pouch bulges downward. Beak goes from (490, 115) to (600, 150), pouch curves back down to head.

Wings: from body (~380, 190) to handlebars (480, 205).

Legs: from lower body (350, 245) down to pedal (400, 355) or so. One leg forward, the other back.

Eye dot. Little feet too. Maybe motion lines and ground line.

Let me write clean SVG with spokes.

Spokes: lines through the wheel center at angles. A few <line> elements, or use a group with rotation. Easier: use a <g> of lines rotated at 30° intervals via transform. Or just draw 6 lines through center (12 spokes): horizontal, vertical, diagonals — lines from center at angle 0 to center at angle 180 etc.

For wheel (200,380) r75: spokes as lines: (125,380)-(275,380), (200,305)-(200,455), diagonals offset ~53: (147,327)-(253,433), (147,433)-(253,327). Good.

Crank and pedals: crank circle r=18 at (380,380). Pedal positions: pedal spindle at (400, 350) and (360, 410). Crank arms drawn from center to these.

Pelican's feet on pedals.

Wing shape: a curved path from the shoulder to the handlebars.

Handlebars: drop bars — a simple curve from (470, 200) to (505, 215).

Let me write the SVG.

Colors: pelican body white/light gray, beak orange/yellow with pink pouch, dark webbed feet. Bike frame red or teal. Background maybe sky. Add subtle ground.

Seat: small rectangle/ellipse at (345, 235), tilted slightly.

Seat tube: from (352, 240) to (380, 380). Top tube from (355, 245) to (490, 235). Down tube from (380, 380) to (505, 265). Head tube (490, 230)-(510, 268). Fork from (508, 266) curving to (560, 380). Chainstays from (200, 380) to (380, 380). Seatstays from (200,380) to (352,245).

Frame stroke width ~7, color #e63946.

Wheels: stroke #333, width 6, fill none, with light fill for tires? Tires are the outer circle, rims slightly smaller r=68.

Handlebars: from head tube top (490, 228): stem going up to (488, 208), bars curve: path M 470 200 q 20 -8 35 6 q 10 10 6 22 (drop bar style). Wing reaches to (475, 205).

Pelican body: ellipse cx 355 cy 205 rx 75 ry 48 rotated -10 degrees. Tail feathers: triangle-ish path at the back left. Neck: thick path (stroke width ~20) from (405, 175) to (465, 125), white. Head: circle at (472, 118), r 20. Beak: upper from (486,110) to (595, 140), pouch: path from base of head (480, 130) curving down to (560, 170), then to beak tip (595,142).

Wing: path from (360, 190) via curve to (470, 200), with feather lines.

Legs: stroke-width 7, orange-gray; leg 1: M 340 245 L 380 320 L 400 350; foot at pedal (400, 352): small line. Leg 2 (background, darker): M 330 245 L 355 330 L 358 408, foot at (358, 408).

Pedals: short horizontal line at (400, 352) with width 20, another at (360, 408).

Chain: line from chainring to rear cog — two lines from circle around (380,380) with r=22 to a small circle at (200,380) with r=12. Just draw top line (380,358)-(200,368) and bottom line (380,402)-(200,392) — approximation is good enough.

Add motion lines behind (left side) and a ground line at y=458.

Helmet? Funny but I'll skip it, or add a small cycling cap — cute. Let me add a tiny red cap on the head: an arc path on top of the head, with a brim. Optional, small.

Eye: (478, 112), circle r 3.5, black.

Let me write the SVG. Canvas 800x500 viewBox.

Check overlap: body ellipse cy 205 ry 48 → top 157, bottom 253; seat top at 235 — seat under body is fine. Seat post: line from (352, 240) to (356, 232)? Seat at (350, 232). Body covers the seat — fine.

Neck stroke: path M 405 180 Q 440 130 468 122, stroke width 24, color white, stroke-linecap round.

Feather details on body: a couple of curved lines.

Ground shadow: an ellipse cx 380 cy 462 rx 250 ry 10, faint.

Let me write the final answer with code block and brief explanation.
